# KayKit Dungeon Remastered — selected runtime subset

Room-shell source: [KayKit Dungeon Pack](https://kaylousberg.itch.io/kaykit-dungeon-pack).

The original pack is distributed under CC0 1.0. `LICENSE.txt` is the unmodified upstream license text. This repository intentionally includes only the GLB files used by the formal-map PCG test: wooden floors, low walls, doorways, corners, stairs, and a small prop set.

Mini Dungeon remains in `assets/third_party/kenney_mini_dungeon` for the later battle-map pillar and terrain-block pass; it is not the room-shell source.
